mapper.select: SELECT ID AS lotId, LotCode AS lotCode, IsUsed AS isUsed, DescFlexSegments_PubDescSeg13 AS preLevel, #{itemCode} AS itemCode FROM [dbo].[Lot_LotMaster] WHERE ItemCode = #{itemCode}

update.if: update [dbo].[Lot_LotMaster] SET DescFlexSegments_PubDescSeg13 =(CASE WHEN #{preLevel} = 'A' THEN 1 WHEN #{preLevel} = 'B' THEN 2 WHEN #{preLevel} = 'C' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END) WHERE ItemCode = #{itemCode} AND LotCode = #{lotCode}
update [dbo].[Lot_LotMaster] SET IsUsed = 1 WHERE ItemCode = #{itemCode} AND LotCode = #{lotCode}
